title: Dollar steadies as traders await CPI data
body: The US dollar held firm against major peers as markets positioned ahead of the upcoming inflation report.

title: ECB signals caution on rate cuts
body: European Central Bank officials struck a cautious tone, suggesting policy will stay data-dependent through year end.

title: Sterling rallies on stronger GDP print
body: The British pound gained after growth figures beat expectations, easing recession fears.

title: Yen weakens as BOJ holds steady
body: The Japanese yen slipped after the central bank kept policy unchanged, disappointing hawkish bets.

title: Gold climbs on safe-haven demand
body: Bullion prices rose as geopolitical tensions pushed investors toward safer assets.

title: Aussie dollar firms on retail sales beat
body: The Australian dollar edged higher after consumer spending data topped forecasts.

title: Oil prices weigh on Canadian dollar
body: The loonie softened as crude prices retreated on demand concerns.

title: Markets brace for US jobs report
body: Traders trimmed positions ahead of the non-farm payrolls release, expecting volatility across majors.

title: Swiss franc gains on risk-off sentiment
body: The franc strengthened as investors sought safety amid broader market jitters.

title: Kiwi dollar under pressure after jobs data
body: The New Zealand dollar fell as employment figures came in mixed, clouding the rate outlook.

title: China PMI beat lifts risk sentiment
body: Stronger-than-expected manufacturing data from China boosted risk appetite across Asian markets.

title: Eurozone inflation ticks higher
body: Flash CPI data showed inflation edging up, complicating the ECB's path to further easing.
